summary: Explore a vast range of basin with overflow, available in an extensive array of styles and configurations for any bathroom space and vision.
title: Basins With Overflow, Made Simple
bodyHtml:
Soul 4H Basin with Overflow

Overflow, but make it Stylish

As regulations continue to evolve, the demand for basins with overflow has become increasingly important.

At Studio Bagno, we’ve made it easy to find the perfect washbasin with overflow by curating a specialised collection — offering a wide range of styles to suit any bathroom project.


Synthesis 70 Wall Hung Basin with Overflow - 700 x 430 x 145 mm

A Configuration for Every Project

From counter-top and under-counter basins to wall-hung and integrated vanity tops, our collection covers any configuration to ensure seamless integration into any bathroom space.

Whether you’re designing for compact powder rooms, luxurious hotel suites, or high-traffic commercial spaces, our selection balances form and function with precision.


Ovale Undercounter with Overflow - 550 x 380 x 185 mm

A Basin for any Design Direction

Overflow doesn’t mean compromise. Our basins are available in a variety of styles and finishes, from ultra-chic contemporary designs to timeless classics.

With options in matte and gloss finishes, as well as a deep selection of statement colour ceramics, there’s a perfect solution for every design vision.


Soul 4 Inset with Overflow - 550 x 420 x 130 mm


Apartment 35 Semi-Recessed with Overflow - 350 x 350 x 150 mm

Innovative Hidden Overflow Technology

For those seeking a sleek, uninterrupted look, select designs feature cutting-edge syphonic overflow technology—an invisible system that only activates when basin capacity is reached, eliminating the need for an exposed overflow hole.


Unlimited 47 V2 with Innovative Hidden Syphonic Overflow - 453 x 453 x 115 mm

Overflow, redefined with versatililty at the forefront
